Do not implement based on independent judgment. Check DESIGN.md build configuration, package.json dependencies, and analyze error messages in detail.

Use astStore, parseErrorStore, selectedNodeStore, expandedNodesStore. Enable strict mode; explicitly write type definitions; avoid magic numbers, use constants; use `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`; single-responsibility components; explicitly type props; BEM recommended; global styles in `src/styles/global.css`; component styles in `<style>`. Use go/parser for Go AST analysis. Use Vite's vite-plugin-singlefile; inline all JS/CSS
